verses.1: Oh clap your hands, all ye peoples; Shout unto God with the voice of triumph.
verses.2: For Jehovah Most High is terrible; He is a great King over all the earth.
verses.3: He subdueth peoples under us, And nations under our feet.
verses.4: He chooseth our inheritance for us, The glory of Jacob whom he loved. [Selah
verses.5: God is gone up with a shout, Jehovah with the sound of a trumpet.
verses.6: Sing praises to God, sing praises: Sing praises unto our King, sing praises.
verses.7: For God is the King of all the earth: Sing ye praises with understanding.
verses.8: God reigneth over the nations: God sitteth upon his holy throne.
verses.9: The princes of the peoples are gathered together To be the people of the God of Abraham; For the shields of the earth belong unto God: He is greatly exalted.
